text: Path-scope confines reads and writes to cwd ∪ allowedPaths (the ceiling), with precedence disallowedPaths > allowedPaths > base(cwd) read as narrowing that ceiling — allowedPaths widen the base up to it, disallowedPaths carve out from within it.
